_about: Dispatch It getting-started tour. Each slide: title, text, optional shot (a screenshot name from shots.py) with points [[pin number on that screenshot, what it does], ...], or a diagram [[title, detail], ...]. Built by guides/lib/build.py; keep wording plain and match the app's labels exactly.
intro: A quick walk through the screens with real screenshots. Pick the path that fits you; you can take the other one after.

done.user: That's everything for day-to-day capturing. Tap the ? on Home to replay this tour or open the full guide.
done.admin: Those are the admin jobs. The full guide's Admin section has setup steps, the secrets table and troubleshooting.

user.label: Everyday use
user.blurb: Capturing to ClickUp, confirming, follow-ups and Undo.

slides.title: Unlock once per device
slides.text: The first time you open Dispatch It on a phone or computer, enter the passcode. The device remembers it.
points: Passcode: ask your admin for it.
Unlock.

slides.title: Home
slides.text: One big button for new captures, and the last things you sent from this device.
points: New Capture: smart routing picks the list.
Or choose the destination yourself.
Recent: tap the link icon to open one in ClickUp.
Activity: everything sent from every device, with Undo.

slides.title: Say it once
slides.text: Write it the way you'd say it. Smart routing picks the list, tidies the title, reads dates like “Friday” and priority like “urgent”, and checks for duplicates.
points: What's on your mind?
Hint: optionally pick the business.
Dictate, record a voice note, or attach files.
Route & Send.

slides.title: When it asks first
slides.text: If smart routing isn't sure, or finds a task that looks the same, you decide on the Confirm screen.
points: It found a matching task.
Add as update: comment on that task instead of making a copy.
★ The top pick, with other likely lists below.
Send, or Create new in the chosen list.

slides.title: Filed on its own
slides.text: When smart routing is sure and finds no duplicate, the capture files itself and you land back on Home.
points: Where it went, and how sure it was.
Undo stays for 8 seconds; after that, use Activity.

slides.title: Pick the list yourself
slides.text: From Home, tap “Choose the destination yourself”, pick a business, then a capture type.
points: Each capture type goes to a specific ClickUp list.
Follow-up / Reminder comments on an existing task.
More lists in this space: other ClickUp lists, added automatically.

slides.title: Fill in the form
slides.text: Only the title is required. A check mark confirms it reached ClickUp.
points: Title.
Make this a subtask of another task.
Assignee: anyone on that list.
Send to ClickUp.

slides.title: Follow-ups
slides.text: A follow-up doesn't create a task: it adds your note as a comment on one that already exists.
points: Search for the task, then tap it.
Write the follow-up note.

slides.title: Activity and Undo
slides.text: Every send from every device. Undo deletes a task it created or removes a comment it added.
points: How often suggestions were kept.
Undo takes two taps: Undo, then Confirm?
Open it in ClickUp.

slides.title: Help is one tap away
slides.text: Tap the ? on Home any time.
points: Replay this tour.
Open the full guide: every screen and setting.

admin.label: Admin
admin.blurb: ClickUp connection, auto-filing, sync, destinations and the passcode.

slides.title: Settings aren't locked
diagram: Shared by everyone who uses the app
slides.text: There's no separate admin login. Share the passcode only with people you trust, and agree that Settings is for admins.

slides.title: Connect ClickUp
slides.text: Connect once; the connection is stored on the server, so every device works.
points: Connect to ClickUp opens ClickUp's approval screen.
Re-check confirms it.
Status lines name any problem.

slides.title: Auto-filing
slides.text: A capture files itself only when it scores at or above the threshold and no likely duplicate is found. Otherwise people see the Confirm screen.
points: Auto-file when confident: on or off.
Cautious 92%, Balanced 85% (default), Bold 75%.
How strict the duplicate check is on manual sends.

slides.title: Keep ClickUp in sync
slides.text: With live updates on, new ClickUp lists and task changes arrive within seconds; a sync also runs every 15 minutes.
points: Sync workspace reads every space and list now.
Build task index turns on duplicate detection.
Live updates on or off.

slides.title: Destinations
slides.text: New ClickUp lists show up on their own. To add or rename a capture type, edit mkp-dispatch/js/config.js and publish the change.
points: Lists found by syncing ClickUp appear here.

slides.title: Passcode and secrets
slides.text: Change the passcode with “wrangler secret put APP_PASSCODE”. Each device then taps Forget passcode and enters the new one. Never paste secrets in chat or email.
points: Forget passcode on this device.
Replay this tour from Settings › Help.

slides.title: This guide keeps itself current
diagram: An automatic GitHub job rebuilds the guide and this tour
Add an entry to mkp-dispatch/CHANGELOG.md; everyone sees it once
slides.text: If a button the guide points at is renamed or removed, the job stops and GitHub emails you, so the guide never quietly goes out of date.
